verdict.rationale: The engine is published as open source on GitHub (playcanvas/engine). A runtime probe confirms the npm 'playcanvas' engine is MIT-licensed, so developers can read, fork and modify the full engine source. Independent community comments also describe it as an open-source engine. Missing for 10: documented guidance on building or patching the engine from source and swapping a custom build into projects, plus hands-on reports of developers modifying engine internals.
